source.question: Which wells need attention right now, and why?

note: Fair (synthetic field): 1% written but not declared.

submission.summary: P-1 needs attention first at 90% water cut and 146 Sm3/d on 100% choke with its downhole gauge dead 997 days since 2018-04-10, while water injector I-2 has been stopped since 2019-08-31 leaving 2020 voidage replacement at 0.78. P-4 is the field's biggest current producer at 795 Sm3/d but stepped down 31% around 2020-02-23 and still declines, and P-2's water cut has climbed to 31% and bears watching.

findings.claim: P-1 is on alarm at 90% water cut and 146 Sm3/d on fully open choke, having made 43% of field oil but now water-dominated.
findings.detail: Field screen as of 2020-12-31: oil_rate 145.97 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.903, uptime 0.9901, 90d change -0.125, share 0.4315 (E1/E2). Water cut first >0.05 on 2016-08-02, >0.50 on 2017-08-10, >0.80 on 2018-03-20; regime shifts 0.0487->0.468 on 2017-03-19 and 0.468->0.875 on 2017-11-12. Oil rate shifts 2865->823 (-71%) on 2017-08-13 and 823->258 (-69%) on 2018-06-17. Waterflood: 2020 liquid 1822 Sm3/d and choke 100% since 2018-03 (was 3258 Sm3/d, 40.38% in 2015), WOR 9.31, remaining oil to 0.95 cut 192412 Sm3. Exponential decline after 2018-06-17: qi 407.65, di 0.3959/yr, r2_log 0.9418, n 904.

findings.claim: P-1's downhole pressure gauge has read zero for 997 days since 2018-04-10 while the well produced 261,474 Sm3 oil without pressure data.
findings.detail: Gauge failure from 2018-04-10 to 2020-12-31: 997 zero days, 972 flowing days, 261474 Sm3 oil during, last good 240.23 bar on 2018-04-09 (E3). Field screen confirms 997 days, 261474 Sm3 since 2018-04-10.

findings.claim: Water injector I-2 has been stopped since 2019-08-31, and field voidage replacement fell to 0.78 in 2020 from 1.33 in 2018.
findings.detail: I-2 no injection since 2019-08-31 (E2), I-1 injecting 3150 Sm3/d. Field voidage replacement_ratio 0.7827 in 2020 (low 0.7476 high 0.8214), 1.33 in 2018, 1.04 in 2019, 1.05 in 2017 (E7). Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3.

findings.claim: P-4 is on caution after a 31% step down around 2020-02-23 to 898 Sm3/d and now flows 795 Sm3/d on a steep harmonic decline.
findings.detail: Step down 1304->897.53 Sm3/d (-31.18%) on 2020-02-23 (E4). Current rate 795.49 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.02, uptime 0.9282, 90d change -0.0772 (E2). December 2020 monthly 767.21 Sm3/d, water cut 0.02, choke 60% (E12). Harmonic fit window 2020-02-23 to 2020-12-31: qi 1069, di 0.4841/yr, b 1.0, r2_log 0.8003, n 307 (E9). Liquid 932 Sm3/d in 2020 vs 1370 in 2019, no WOR trend (WOR 0.02041).

findings.claim: P-2's water cut has risen to 31% in late 2020 from near 1% historically, after two oil-rate steps down of 45% and 65%.
P-3 is stable on water but its oil rate stepped down 46% around 2019-03-24 to 335 Sm3/d and now makes 258 Sm3/d.

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.summary: 30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2016-08-02, 19 months after first oil.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2017-08-10, 31 months after first oil.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.8 on 2018-03-20, 38 months after first oil.
bhp_bar reads 0 on 997 days from 2018-04-10 to 2020-12-31 while the well kept flowing on 972 days (261,474 Sm3 oil): a sensor failure, not a pressure collapse. Last good reading: 240.2 on 2018-04-09.
Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 291 -> 283 Sm3/d (-3%) after restart. Same time as P-2, P-3, P-4.
Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 1,482 -> 1,411 Sm3/d (-5%) after restart. Same time as P-1, P-2, P-3.
Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 414 -> 405 Sm3/d (-2%) after restart. Same time as P-1, P-3, P-4.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2019-07-22, 53 months after first oil.
Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 426 -> 404 Sm3/d (-5%) after restart. Same time as P-1, P-2, P-4.

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.
